summary_rationale: NIKE, Inc. retains formidable scale ($46.40B FY2026 revenue, ~14% of the $330B athletic market), Investment Grade liquidity ($8.37B cash & ST investments at Aug 31, 2026), and early North America wholesale traction (+9% in Q1 FY2027). However, the November 17, 2026 Investor Day ('Full Stride Ahead') confirmed a deeper near-term trough: FY2027 revenue is guided down high-single digits with adjusted operating margin compressing to ~6% and adjusted EPS falling to $1.15–$1.35, while market-level growth is deferred until FY2029 and Pace requires ~$1.3B in restructuring charges. Footnote forensics also reveal $3.18B in operating lease liabilities ($2.70B lease-adjusted net debt), $15.5B in rigid endorsement obligations, 2025 S&P/Moody's downgrades, Q1 FY2027 CFO dropping to $135M (-$64M FCF) despite IEEPA tariff cash collection, Greater China inventory rising +7.6% QoQ amid -26% CC sales, an unresolved Belgian Customs dispute, and Swoosh, LLC Class A voting control (8 of 11 directors), keeping the business squarely in CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL / PASS_WITH_WATCH.
